petergyang.en:
If you're stuck in the Bay Area tech rat race / psychosis, make time to travel to other places.

Go to a small town in Europe or visit Asia - you'll see that life can be about much more than whether you're IC7 or IC8 or what company you work for.

Don't be the person to put on your tombstone: "He got divorced and neglected his kids but at least he made D2 at FAANG"
petergyang.zh:
如果您陷入湾区科技激烈的竞争/精神病中，请腾出时间去其他地方旅行。

去欧洲的一个小镇或访问亚洲 - 您会发现生活不仅仅关乎您是 IC7 还是 IC8 或您为哪家公司工作。

不要成为刻在你墓碑上的人：“他离婚了，忽视了孩子，但至少他在 FAANG 取得了 D2 的成绩”

realmadhuguru.en:
I have friends who made $10M+ and are miserable. I have friends who made that much and found calm - they don’t need to run anymore. 

I have friends who made far less and are just happy.

Whether something is enough is up to you. Whether you’re happy is independent of your bank account.

You can want to be wealthy and still be content now. You don’t need to chase it from a place of lack and desperation.

Silicon Valley treats ambition and happiness as mutually exclusive. As if wanting more means you can’t be satisfied now.

That’s the trap. You can be both
realmadhuguru.zh:
我有一些朋友赚了 1000 万美元以上，但他们很痛苦。我有一些朋友赚了那么多钱后感到平静——他们不需要再跑步了。 

我有一些朋友的收入要少得多，但他们很快乐。

某件事是否足够取决于你。您是否快乐与您的银行账户无关。

你可能想要变得富有，但现在仍然感到满足。你不需要从缺乏和绝望的地方去追逐它。

硅谷认为野心和幸福是相互排斥的。好像想要更多就意味着你现在无法满足。

这就是陷阱。你可以两者兼而有之

garrytan.en:
What is GBrain? My open source project is a knowledge system, not RAG in a box. 

It gives agents 8 layers that work together to improve memory in a way that makes your already smart OpenClaw or Hermes Agent feel clairvoyant about who you are. 

Personal AI becomes possible.
garrytan.zh:
什么是GBrain？我的开源项目是一个知识系统，而不是盒子里的RAG。 

它为代理提供了 8 层，这些层协同工作以提高记忆力，使您已经很聪明的 OpenClaw 或 Hermes 代理能够洞察您是谁。 

个人人工智能成为可能。

nikunj.en:
A lot of young people ask me if they should move to venture and my answer is typically no* for the following reason..

It’s hard to truly understand what “excellence” means unless you’re deeply embedded and working for founders who are truly excellent. Even if you are part of the cap table and the board and spending time with founders, you don’t get same learnings as working at a company day in and day out. 

I wouldn’t know anything about product excellence if it were not for @deepnishar @ericwu01 @acv and others. 

I wouldn’t know anything about design if it were not for @kurtvarner @MicahSivitz @xiakv and others. 

I wouldn’t know anything about operational excellence if it were not for @rabois @danubata and others. 

Only because of these experiences and reading deeply, I was able to create some heuristics of what great founders and companies look like. And I have to keep updating it as I meet more and more founders and technology shifts beneath us. Those experiences also helped me earn the right to win the right to be a part of founders cap table.

The other main reason to not be a junior investor is for most firms you’re just sourcing founders that match the GPs taste vs. truly thinking from first principles on what makes great founders & companies. 

If you really want to invest in  founders, work at a great company and start by being be an angel. It’s such a fun way to learn and be part of founders journey. 

* The one exception to this is you’re absolutely obsessed with the craft of investing and you really cannot fathom doing any other job. If that’s your true passion then you’ll figure out a way to be a great investor regardless of anything you have done in the past.
nikunj.zh:
很多年轻人问我是否应该去创业，我的回答通常是否定的*，原因如下。

除非你深深地融入并为真正优秀的创始人工作，否则很难真正理解“卓越”的含义。即使你是股权结构表和董事会的一员，并与创始人共度时光，你也无法获得与日复一日在公司工作相同的知识。 

如果没有 @deepnishar @ericwu01 @acv 和其他人，我对产品卓越一无所知。 

如果没有@kurtvarner @MicahSivitz @xiakv 和其他人，我对设计一无所知。 

如果没有 @rabois @danubata 和其他人，我对卓越运营一无所知。 

正是因为这些经历和深入的阅读，我才能够对伟大的创始人和公司的面貌产生一些启发。随着我遇到越来越多的创始人和我们下面的技术转变，我必须不断更新它。这些经历也帮助我赢得了成为创始人股权结构表一部分的权利。

不成为初级投资者的另一个主要原因是，对于大多数公司来说，你只是寻找符合 GP 品味的创始人，而不是真正从基本原则出发思考什么造就了伟大的创始人和公司。 

如果你真的想投资创始人，那就在一家伟大的公司工作，然后从成为一名天使开始。这是一种非常有趣的学习方式并成为创始人旅程的一部分。 

* 唯一的例外是，你完全沉迷于投资技巧，而且你真的无法想象做任何其他工作。如果这是你真正的热情，那么无论你过去做过什么，你都会找到一种方法成为一名伟大的投资者。

No Priors.zh:
演讲者 1 | 00:00 - 00:33
我们不会建立政府运营的供应链，因为这不是我们作为一个国家的闪光点。我们的超级大国实际上是我们的私营部门和我们的公司。老史蒂夫·乔布斯曾说过，美国产品令世界各地数十亿用户着迷和愉悦。这确实是我们作为一个国家的优势。因此，答案就是努力与我们的私营公司和我们的建设者同步工作，打造商业上可行的平台，并最终实现这一目标。
